cover.kicker: 封面故事 · 社区热议
cover.title:
NVIDIA auto-ontology 两天涨到 2,322 星
HN 上 289 分
cover.dek: 它想解决的是 Agent 查对了库、却用错业务口径的问题。日增 +1,829，HN 上有 139 条评论，不全是转发和带货，讨论比较实在。
cover.title_en:
NVIDIA's auto-ontology
Draws 289 Points on HN
cover.dek_en: It targets agents that query the right database but apply the wrong business definitions. It added 1,829 stars in a day and 139 HN comments, so the discussion looks organic.

stickers.title: Skills 回升
stickers.text: cloudflare/security-audit-skill 近 3 天从 777 涨到 2,417,mattpocock/skills 也升到 2,043。
stickers.text_en: cloudflare/security-audit-skill went from 777 to 2,417 stars a day in 3 days. mattpocock/skills reached 2,043.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Switch-SWE 测任务切换后的恢复能力,其上下文管理插件把完成率提高 5.5–15.5 个百分点。
stickers.text_en: Switch-SWE tests recovery after task switches. Its context plugin lifts completion rates by 5.5 to 15.5 points.

stickers.title: 曝光落差
stickers.text: elephant-goldfish-model 视频播放约 489,100,HN 5 帖各只有 1–2 分。
stickers.text_en: Videos on elephant-goldfish-model drew about 489,100 views, while its 5 HN posts got 1 to 2 points each.
